additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380252-DC/Si-D/FR-[NEScsD]- Door Button seems defective CRM:00645000778
additional_info.body:
Hi Nicolas,
Hope you're doing well.
Could you please let us know if you're facing the door lock issue with only this charger or with other chargers as well?
The Si-D lock button typically requires a good amount of pressure to press and open the door. If the button or lock is only getting stuck on this charger, it might be an issue with that specific lock. However, if you experience the same pressure with all the chargers, then it might be normal.
Thank you.
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380252-DC/Si-D/FR-[NEScsD]- Door Button seems defective CRM:00645000778
additional_info.body:
Hi,
No, I only face this problem on this charger. I have no problem opening the other chargers.
On this charger, we need 2 people. One person who pushes the door into the closed position so that it is fully pressed against the charger, and another person who presses the push button (sometimes even with the help of the key cover to have more strength).
I'm making the ticket because, last time, I was alone, and I managed to open the door after a 10 minute-struggle.
Best regards,
